newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse urges market caution on FIN1 trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse urges market caution on FIN1 trade.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand on Wednesday urged investors to exercise caution when they resume trading shares of long suspended Finance One Plc on Friday.
The exchange said in a statement that investors should carefully weigh recent information released by Finance One on its first quarter performance and market rumours about its financial health.
It said Finance One shares would not be cushioned by a normal 10 percent daily limit low when they resume trading on Friday after a three-month suspension.
Analysts have voiced concerns that an expected tumble of Finance One shares on Friday could pull down the whole market which closed Wednesday at near its eight year low.
Market concerns about Finance One's future were aggravated by collapse last Friday of talks of its planned merger with Thai Danu Bank Plc.
Finance One posted a 4.61 billion baht consolidated first quarter loss against a 632.6 million baht profit a year ago.
Finance One told market analysts on Wednesday its current book value stood at 12.14 baht a share but brokers said it traded at only three to four baht in the unofficial grey market.
The stock was last officially traded in the Thai bourse at 23.75 baht on February 28.
